score_change_reason: The judge's line-level note that M25 and Q04 are already registered in the Factor DB removes one infrastructure concern from my R1 case. I still remain negative overall because the main issues—Q04's 40% sleeve risk, missing liquidity-filtered net quintile evidence, and issuer-level PIT timing/amendment handling—are still unresolved.

agreements.point: I agree that Harvey/DSR evidence is still too weak to waive further validation and that TDC/DCC must be measured before approval; those are real gates, not cosmetic follow-ups.

I agree that the M25 regime-label inconsistency is a genuine L-120 problem. If ic_bad is positive while the registry crisis tag is negative, the crisis-diversifier narrative is not yet internally coherent.
I also agree that Factor DB registration appears to be confirmed at the cited lines, which weakens my earlier 'registration unconfirmed' concern.

rebuttals.point: I disagree that AX-004/005/007 scope exemption is already justified. A 40% Q04 weight is too large to treat as a harmless filter; until standalone and incremental net-of-cost evidence shows Q04 adds alpha rather than re-importing failed KR quality exposure, the prior failure analogy still matters.

I disagree that this is merely a conditional-approval case because downside protection and recent_3y IC look supportive. Those points are downstream of the unresolved PIT timing and liquidity-filtered quintile conversion problem; without them, the backtest may not represent a tradable KR PEAD signal at all.

strongest_opposing_argument: The judge's argument that the composite may qualify for AX-004/005/007 scope relief because Q04 is acting as a filter inside a multi-sleeve design, not as a standalone quality bet, is the strongest challenge to my rejection thesis.
kill_scenarios_update: Added: even if standalone alpha survives, the proposal can still fail at portfolio level if M25 is classified into the consensus/momentum family and pushes family concentration above 35%, or if TDC/DCC versus STR_1631 breaches the 0.30 diversification threshold during crisis regimes.
